title: Karl Maria Wiligut, Himmler's SS seer of the Nordic past

tellings.quote: source in a guy called Vice, Carl Villigut, right? who claimed he had photographic memory of what it was like back in the day when there were only Nordics on the planet.

plain: A researcher and author, Peter Levenda, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, tells of a man named Karl Maria Wiligut who advised Heinrich Himmler, head of the Nazi SS, in 1930s Germany. Levenda says Wiligut claimed a kind of photographic memory of ancient times, when, in his telling, only Nordic people lived on the planet. Levenda brings him up as a source the Nazi leadership drew on for its ideas about a lost Nordic past.
